uncertainties: Children's euphemistic 'that' from playing with fire preserved; source does not speak the bedwetting superstition aloud.
text:
Lady Misumi. We will
see to the matter ourselves!
Hmm...
But it has been so long.
I'd like to go into battle too.
When I say no,
I mean no!
And please,
do not say things
that encourage Lady Misumi.
I beg you...
A-all right...
You'd better not.
W-well...
Perhaps you shouldn't.
Hmm...
But it has been so long.
I'd like to go into battle too.
You can't
just leave Subaru
on his own, can you?
Oh...
It is because you remain here
that I can leave
the settlement without worry.
I understand how you feel,
but please
restrain yourself in this.
Yes...
I was being thoughtless.
I shall be more careful.
Phew...
It really scared me.
We were all playing hide-and-seek
when we started smelling
something burning...
We went to look,
and the straw pile was on fire.
I got Ishlar,
who'd been playing with us,
and we put it out.
Fortunately, only a small part
burned. But if it had spread
to the surrounding mountains...
The very thought
gives me chills.
I have to ask: neither of you
did anything that might
have started a fire, did you?
Listen, you two.
You didn't do anything that might
have started a fire, did you?
We didn't!
Fire's dangerous.
We've been told never
to use it without a grown-up.
Yeah...
And besides, you know...
Yeah, they say if you play
with fire, you'll do
you-know-what...
You-know-what?
...
Really!?
Mother said
that's what they say
in Silturn.
Huh...
From the sound of it,
there's no chance the children
started the fire...
From the sound of it,
there's no chance the children
started the fire...
A moment, please...
I hate to think it,
but did you...?
Forgive me for asking,
but did you...?
I started the fire.
